CLIC1 in the regulation of actin cytoskeletal pathways

Role of CLIC1 in the regulation of actin cytoskeletal pathways. The red asterisks (*) mark specific components that show a significant correlation with CLIC1 expression, emphasizing its potential role in modulating these pathways. CLIC, chloride intracellular channel
